```yaml
name: Prompt Test - Sentry Integration

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'trigger.config.ts'
      - 'packages/**/trigger.config.ts'
      - '.github/workflows/prompt-test.yml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'

jobs:
  validate-sentry-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 8

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Check Sentry dependencies
        run: |
          echo "Checking for Sentry dependencies in package.json..."
          if grep -q "@sentry/node" package.json && grep -q "@sentry/esbuild-plugin" package.json; then
            echo "Sentry dependencies found."
          else
            echo "Sentry dependencies missing."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate trigger.config.ts structure
        run: |
          echo "Validating trigger.config.ts for Sentry integration..."
          if [ -f "trigger.config.ts" ]; then
            if grep -q "Sentry" trigger.config.ts && grep -q "onFailure" trigger.config.ts; then
              echo "Sentry integration found in trigger.config.ts."
            else
              echo "Sentry integration not properly configured in trigger.config.ts."
              exit 1
            fi
          else
            echo "trigger.config.ts not found."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Check for test task
        run: |
          echo "Checking for Sentry error test task..."
          if find . -name "sentry-error-test.ts" -o -name "*sentry*test*.ts" | grep -q .; then
            echo "Sentry test task found."
          else
            echo "Sentry test task not found."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Verify environment variables in workflows
        run: |
          echo "Checking for Sentry environment variables in workflows..."
          if grep -r "SENTRY_DSN" .github/workflows/ || grep -r "SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN" .github/workflows/; then
            echo "Sentry environment variables found in workflows."
          else
            echo "Sentry environment variables missing in workflows."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Build project
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Run type checking
        run: pnpm typecheck
```
